section_summary.extract_value: This abstract reports a single study of 322 female university students examining associations among consideration of cosmetic surgery, media influence (SATAQ-3), body appreciation (BAS), and demographics including BMI. Results indicated consideration of cosmetic surgery correlated positively with some media influence subscales and negatively with body appreciation, age, and BMI; regression showed greater media influence, lower body appreciation, and lower BMI predicted consideration of cosmetic surgery. The abstract does not provide country, survey method, mean age, mean BMI, numeric correlation coefficients, or explicit study labels (e.g., 'Study 1').
section_summary.evidence_source: "The current study examined the association between consideration of cosmetic surgery, body appreciation, media influence, and participant demographics." and "In total, 322 female university students completed... the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS)..." and "Bivariate correlations showed... negatively correlated with BAS scores, age, and body mass index (BMI). A multiple regression showed that the only significant predictors... were greater media influence, less body appreciation, and lower BMI."
